  end

  end

end

  end
  find_gem_template(relative_path)
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = nil
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

  rescue StandardError => e

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(nil, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, nil)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if nil
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(nil, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if true
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = nil
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise("Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{nil}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = template_path
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError)
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

    template = self.parse(template_content)

    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e

    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = template_content
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(nil)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    nil
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e

  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    nil
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(nil, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{nil}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise("Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{self.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, nil)
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError)
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end

def render_template(site, template_name, variables)
  template_path = find_template_path(site, template_name)
  if template_path.nil?
    raise(TemplateNotFoundError, "Template not found: #{template_name}")
  end

  begin
    template_content = File.read(template_path)
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(template_content)
    template.render(variables)
  rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EACCES => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Failed to read template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Encoding::InvalidByteSequenceError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Invalid encoding in template '#{template_name}' at #{template_path}: #{e.message}")
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, Liquid::Error => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Liquid error in template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise(TemplateRenderError, "Unexpected error rendering template '#{template_name}': #{e.message}")
  end
end
